percentiles: Nearest rank; no interpolation. n10 and n6 p95 equals maximum; no statistical significance claimed.
metricNotes: Cold browser contexts use warm local Next/Auth/PostgreSQL services; hosted cold starts and region effects are not measured.
Every cohort/profile/path/condition remains separate. Failed/censored rows are counted, never replaced.
The supplementary workflow has warm assets and a freshly prepared Overview document; it uses the real Overview CTA. The primary collector retains its original menu/keyboard path.
Workflow total includes separately reported automation gaps and close actions; no human think-time claim.
Source-plus-click sums the actual two intervals in each row, then computes quantiles; it never adds separate quantiles.
Server phases overlap. Database aggregates and lock-bearing queries do not isolate pure pool/lock/provider waits.
Request-window differences can include background polling; they are not proof of causal request elimination.
Failed request counts include aborted navigation/background requests, even when useful content succeeded. They are not silently dropped.
Capacity requests within one burst share load and are correlated; pool counts are same-role aggregates, not per-client or hosted capacity proof.

excludedAttempts.reason: Whole attempt excluded: actual sleep events
